# CNGist compatibility rules

Fixed copies of search and tier display rules, plus the challenge display-name function, from
[CNGist](https://github.com/CNGoldenTopList/CNGist/tree/09481eda74aa91b9e09bebebb4e6e7ace31cfcf5/shared/src).

Source revision: `09481eda74aa91b9e09bebebb4e6e7ace31cfcf5`.
Local tier types replace the upstream type-only import; runtime rules are unchanged.
When upstream naming, search or tier semantics change, review and sync these files explicitly.
This repository does not need a sibling CNGist checkout to build.
